payload.name: Include all explicit activities from multi-message event narratives
payload.description: When extracting an event memory from multiple messages about the same trip, experience, or event, before composing the candidate re-read all source messages and include every explicitly mentioned activity, place, or excursion.
content: During extraction, after drafting an event memory from a multi-message conversation, scan every source message in the session for explicitly stated activities, places, or excursions. If a later message adds an activity not yet in the candidate, add it to the candidate rather than keeping only the first message's details.

Use the full message set as the source of truth for event memories; do not treat the first mention as exhaustive. When the same event is described across turns, compose a candidate that covers all explicit facts, then pass it to CRUD as a single complete ADD or UPDATE.

solves: When a construction agent condenses a multi-message travel or event narrative into one memory candidate, it may fixate on the first message and drop explicit activities stated in later messages. This rule forces re-scanning all source messages for every explicitly named activity or location before composing the candidate. It applies to any multi-message event summary where later messages add facts; it does not apply to single-message extractions or to deduplicating already-captured memories.
